description.value: Casa Beto is a Mexican food truck rooted in traditional home-cook recipes, emphasising fresh locally sourced ingredients. For the 2026 season it operates out of Sunday Cider on the Sunshine Coast Highway in Gibsons. It is a takeout-only operation, making it a convenient roadside stop for cyclists travelling the Sunshine Coast route.

raw_osm.name: Casa Beto

No bike parking, water refill, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere.
